action: Deploy the verified registration selector fix as one frontend revision

execution.canary_or_reason: Single frontend release; anonymous route verification is the canary before broader acceptance
execution.concurrency_control: Deploy only the committed candidate from the active BBU repository branch
execution.idempotency_or_reason: One immutable Git revision and one provider deployment identifier
execution.monitoring_window: Fresh desktop and mobile registration checks immediately after deployment

validation.method: Read back the exact production signup route and exercise Yes/No pointer, touch, keyboard, validation, and forward-progress behavior
validation.rollback_or_containment: Stop further changes and redeploy the retained prior healthy revision if route load or registration validation regresses
